title: Error 3 - Low Battery
fullDescription:
Yale Assure locks display Error 3 with repeated beeps when batteries approach end-of-life. The lock continues to function but will soon stop responding if not replaced.

Emergency 9V terminals on the bottom of some Yale models allow unlocking when batteries are fully dead.

fixSteps.title: Replace 4 AAs
fixSteps.instruction: Open interior battery cover, replace all four AA batteries.

faq.q: Can I unlock with dead batteries?
faq.a: Touch a 9V battery to the terminals on the lock exterior.

title: Error 4 - Motor Fault
shortDescription: Drive motor stalled or drew excessive current.
fullDescription:
Error 4 indicates the motor could not complete a locking cycle. Root causes include strike plate bind, debris in mechanism, or a failing motor.

If the problem persists with the door open, the motor assembly may need replacement.

fixSteps.title: Test with door open
fixSteps.instruction: Lock cycles freely with door open suggests alignment issue.

fixSteps.title: Realign strike plate
fixSteps.instruction: Reposition strike for free bolt travel.

whenToCallPro: If lock fails with door open, call a locksmith to replace the assembly.

faq.a: Yes, Yale provides a limited warranty on the electronic components.

title: Error 5 - Fingerprint Not Recognized
shortDescription: Biometric sensor cannot match stored fingerprint.
fullDescription:
On Yale biometric models, Error 5 indicates either a dirty sensor, wet finger, or a fingerprint not enrolled. Three consecutive failures trigger a 30-second lockout.

Re-enroll fingerprints for more reliable recognition.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the sensor with a dry microfiber cloth.

fixSteps.title: Re-enroll fingerprint
fixSteps.instruction: App > Users > Fingerprints > Add. Capture 6-8 angles.

faq.q: How many fingerprints can Yale store?

title: Bluetooth Pairing Failure
shortDescription: Phone and lock cannot complete BLE handshake.
fullDescription:
Pairing failures arise from a stuck BLE state, old Yale Access app, or the lock already being paired to another account.

Factory reset and start pairing within 10 feet of the lock.

fixSteps.title: Reset lock
fixSteps.instruction: Hold reset pinhole with battery pulled; reinsert and continue holding 10s.

faq.q: Do I need internet to pair?
faq.a: Account login requires internet; pairing itself is BLE.

title: Wi-Fi Module Offline or Faulty
shortDescription: Yale Assure Wi-Fi module not responding.
fullDescription:
Yale Assure Lock 2 uses a plug-in Wi-Fi module (or Connect Wi-Fi Bridge on older models). The module can hang after firmware updates or lose its Wi-Fi credentials.

Unplug the module for 30 seconds and re-run Wi-Fi setup.

fixSteps.title: Re-configure Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: In Yale Access > Settings > Wi-Fi Setup.

videoSearchQuery: Yale Assure wifi module not working

faq.q: Can I upgrade an Assure 2 Bluetooth to Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes, a Wi-Fi upgrade module is available.

title: Security Lockout Triggered
shortDescription: Too many incorrect codes triggered 60-second lockout.
fullDescription:
After 5 incorrect codes (factory default), Yale engages a lockout where the keypad beeps and rejects inputs for 60 seconds.

This is a tamper-deterrent. Wait for the timer or unlock from the app.

fixSteps.title: Wait 60 seconds
fixSteps.instruction: Do not press any keys during countdown.

fixSteps.title: Unlock from app
fixSteps.instruction: Open Yale Access and unlock remotely.

faq.q: Can I change attempts before lockout?

title: User Code Slots Full
shortDescription: Lock has reached the maximum of 250 access codes.
fullDescription:
Yale Assure Lock 2 stores up to 250 codes. Attempting to add a new code when full results in a 'Code Full' error.

Delete unused codes to free slots.

fixSteps.title: Review codes
fixSteps.instruction: App > Access > delete expired or unused codes.

videoSearchQuery: Yale Assure code limit full fix

title: Lock Shows Offline
shortDescription: No recent connection from lock to Yale cloud.
fullDescription:
Offline status can be caused by Wi-Fi module disconnection, router outage, or Yale service interruption. Check the Yale status page for service issues.

Remote access is lost until the connection resumes.

fixSteps.title: Check router
fixSteps.instruction: Verify 2.4 GHz SSID broadcasts and internet works.

faq.a: Yes, keypad codes work without internet.

title: Auto-Lock Not Engaging
shortDescription: Lock does not auto-engage after configured timer.
fullDescription:
Yale Auto-Lock requires DoorSense calibration (if enabled) to confirm closed state. If DoorSense shows 'open', Auto-Lock suspends to avoid locking an open door.

Check DoorSense alignment and toggles.

fixSteps.title: Enable Auto-Lock
fixSteps.instruction: App > Auto-Lock > enable and set timer.

videoSearchQuery: Yale Assure auto lock not working

faq.a: Not required, but recommended to avoid locking an open door.

title: HomeKit Pairing Error
shortDescription: Apple Home cannot complete HomeKit pairing.
fullDescription:
Yale Assure supports HomeKit over Thread or Wi-Fi. Pairing fails if the HomeKit code was used previously, iCloud Keychain is out of sync, or the home hub is offline.

Remove from Home, factory reset lock, and re-add with HomeKit code from the sticker.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset lock
fixSteps.instruction: Hold reset pinhole for 10 seconds with batteries in.

fixSteps.title: Add to Home
fixSteps.instruction: Home app > + > Add Accessory > scan HomeKit code on sticker.

faq.a: Yes, select Assure Lock 2 variants include Thread.
